dish.title: Goan Shrimp Ambot Tik: Sour-Spicy Red Chile Curry with Basmati Rice
dish.description: Shrimp simmered in a brick-red, sour-hot Goan curry built on browned onion and tomato and a paste of Kashmiri chili powder, garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric, black pepper, tamarind, and cider vinegar. Served over steamed basmati rice with cilantro.

recipe_version.title: Goan Shrimp Ambot Tik: Sour-Spicy Red Chile Curry with Basmati Rice
recipe_version.description: Shrimp simmered in a brick-red, sour-hot Goan curry built on browned onion and tomato and a paste of Kashmiri chili powder, garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric, black pepper, tamarind, and cider vinegar. Served over steamed basmati rice with cilantro.

ingredients.name: large shrimp (21-25 per lb)
ingredients.display_name: large shrimp (21-25 per lb), peeled and deveined

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1/2 tsp shrimp, 1 tsp curry, 1/2 tsp rice

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Rinse the rice until the rinse runs nearly clear. Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the turmeric and 1/2 tsp salt. In a small bowl stir the chili powder, garlic, ginger, cumin, black pepper, tamarind, vinegar, and sugar into a thick paste. Chop the onion, tomato, and cilantro.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Combine the rice, 2 1/4 cups water, and 1/2 tsp salt in a 2-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil over high, about 4 minutes, then cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes; leave it covered off the heat to rest 10 minutes. The covered cooking and rest run inside steps 3 to 6 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Brown the onion and tomato
steps.body: Heat the oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium. Cook the onion, stirring often, until deep golden, about 8 minutes. Add the tomato and cook until it collapses, about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the paste
steps.body: Add the chile paste and cook, stirring constantly, until it darkens to brick red and the oil separates at the edges, about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer the shrimp
steps.body: Stir in 3/4 cup water and 1 tsp salt and bring to a simmer, then simmer 3 minutes. Add the shrimp and simmer, turning them in the sauce, until pink and opaque throughout, about 4 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Fluff the rice, spoon the curry over, and scatter the cilantro.

coverage_contribution: A shrimp curry, which the catalog does not have (shrimp appear only in a pasta, a boil, and a laksa). Goa is new as a label. It is sour and hot with no coconut, so it does not repeat the coconut seafood stews.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with malaysian-curry-laksa: a thick tamarind-vinegar curry over rice, not a coconut noodle soup. Compared with brazilian-fish-moqueca: shrimp in a chile-vinegar curry, no coconut milk or peppers. Compared with bengali-mustard-fish: shrimp in a red chile paste, not fish in mustard seed sauce. Compared with coconut-chickpea-curry: shellfish, and no coconut.
not_duplicate_of: Not a coconut shrimp curry (xacuti or caldinho).
